newsitem.title: USA: Patrick Industries says Q1 below goals.
newsitem.headline: Patrick Industries says Q1 below goals.

text.p: Patrick Industries Inc said Tuesday its first quarter earnings of $2.1 million or $0.35 a share on sales of $96.9 million did not reach the company's goals for the quarter.
A year ago, it earned $1.9 million or $0.33 a share on sales of $93.8 million.
But the rise in earnings was encouraging, Chairman Mervin Lung said, because the two main industries served by Patrick experienced lower production levels in this quarter.
The reduced activity in manufactured housing and recreational vehicles, and competitive market pricing, hurt income, the company said.
Patrick makes and distributes building materials to manufactured housing, recreational vehicles and other industries.
